name: Shizuma Mitsuaki
source:
"The Guardian Wings are here to protect your smile. So whenever you call my name, I'll always come running."

Appears 18 years old, actual age 217 years.
The executive chairman at Onigasato High School, he's one of the 'Three Wings'.
A cheerful guy who talks with a strange Kansai accent. At his root he's an earnest and empathetic person.
